notes: Appearance has an Interface scale row at 90, 100, 110, 125 and 150 percent, saved across restarts. Spaces now leave cleanly when the owner disconnects, so the network stays up and another member can take over. Switching spaces leaves the current one first and joins the selected one without the red attach error. Creating or joining a space while disconnected no longer connects on its own, a removed selection no longer jumps to another space, and the owner Remove dialog offers Leave space before Delete space. Windows experimental build; the phone stays at 0.7.5.
